units.source_text: 藤壶皇后自从那天患病之后，心情一直不佳。

en.t: Ever since falling ill that day, Empress Fujitsubo had remained in low spirits.

units.source_text: 王命妇等闻得源氏大将故意笼闭一室，音信全无，

en.t: When Omyobu and the others heard that General Genji had deliberately shut himself away in a room and sent no word at all,

units.source_text: 推察他的心情，颇觉对他不起。

en.t: they imagined how he must feel and were deeply sorry for what had been done to him.

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后为皇太子着想，

en.t: Thinking of the Crown Prince, Empress Fujitsubo reflected that

units.source_text: 倘使这个后援人心中有了隔阂，于皇太子甚是不利。

en.t: if this important supporter became estranged in his heart, it would be extremely harmful to the Crown Prince.

units.source_text: 如果他起了厌世之心，毅然出家为僧，毕竟是不幸之事。

en.t: If he grew weary of the world and resolutely became a monk, that would in the end be a great misfortune.

units.source_text: 她一一考虑：“如果他那种妄念一直不断，

en.t: She thought through each matter in turn: "If that deluded passion of his never ceases,

units.source_text: 则我的恶名势必泄露于这浇薄的世间。

en.t: then my disgrace is certain to leak out into this cold and shallow world.
The Kokiden Empress Dowager accuses me of overstepping my station,

units.source_text: 现在何不干脆退出皇后之位呢。”

en.t: so why should I not simply withdraw from the position of empress now?"

units.source_text: 她回想桐壶院在世时对她无微不至的宠爱以及恳切的遗言，

en.t: She recalled the boundless affection the Kiritsubo Emperor had shown her while he lived, as well as his earnest final words,

units.source_text: 觉得现今时世大变，万事面目全非。

en.t: and felt that the world had now changed completely and everything had become unrecognizable.

units.source_text: 我身即使不惨遭戚夫人的命运，

en.t: Even if I do not suffer a fate as terrible as Lady Qi's,

units.source_text: 也一定作天下人的笑柄。

en.t: I will surely become a laughingstock to everyone under heaven.

units.source_text: 她觉得人世可厌，日子难过，决心遁入空门。

en.t: She found the human world hateful and life hard to endure, and resolved to enter the Buddhist path.

units.source_text: 但不见皇太子一面，就此落发改装，

en.t: But to shave her head and change her appearance without seeing the Crown Prince even once

units.source_text: 又不忍心，便微行入宫去见皇太子。

en.t: was more than she could bear, so she went quietly into the palace to see him.
